topics.headline: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
topics.summary_short: Multimodal agents can create complex videos in software such as Blender by coding without relying on diffusion models. Yet video understanding benchmarks still evaluate models mainly through question answering. If an agent truly understands a video, it can reconstruct it programmatically.
topics.why_it_matters: This research paper surfaced across 1 independent source(s).

evidence.title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender

topics.headline_zh: BVB: 通过 Blender 中的程序化重建对智能体视频理解进行基准测试
topics.summary_short_zh: 多模态智能体可以通过编码在 Blender 等软件中创建复杂视频，而无需依赖扩散模型。然而视频理解基准测试仍主要通过问答来评估模型。如果智能体真正理解视频，它应该能够以程序化方式重建视频。
